verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly ship in-product AI insights on transaction data, so this story applies. The evidence only shows AI-facing tooling: MCP servers, the Agentic Wallet CLI and agent skills. These let an external AI assistant query or act on account data, but they are building blocks for other agents, not AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered inside the product. The 'trending tokens' item is an example prompt to an external assistant, not a product insight feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
